title: Replacing Bix: Bonano, Rollison, Red Nichols and McPartland
summary: When Bix was leaving the Wolverines, the band tried Paul Mares, got Sharkey Bonano who was sent home after three tunes, and Fred Rollison declined; they settled on Jimmy McPartland.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
